lines: Maheshkumar Gopalbhai Patel, Promoter Selling Shareholder, is receiving money from selling 4,98,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of {proceeds} have been in hand since about 6 Nov 2026, {event_age}, the listing date.
They keep {retained_shares} after the offer, and lock-in terms mean that stake stays with them for 12 to 36 months.
